about: active_dates gate the manifest's monster_art (the global file) only, through the same check as sprite_replace; the same mod's class art and cell art stay on out of season (spec: class and cell scope are not gated, like other content). The run date does not matter: gnx_scn_set_today moves 'today' and reload_mods runs the loader again. The window is 01-01 to 01-02, both ends included; 03-01 and 01-03 are out. The class and cell asserts hold in every state, so a mod that never loaded cannot pass the global 'off' asserts. The global file's resized world walk (64 x 80, 10 frames) is asserted on, and off: the game's own walk back, size, frames, origin and box (the box once it has been replaced and restored).
